displayName.description: Output only. The "pretty" name of the value of the permission. The following is a list of examples for each type of permission: * `user` - User's full name, as defined for their Google Account, such as "Dana A." * `group` - Name of the Google Group, such as "The Company Administrators." * `domain` - String domain name, such as "cymbalgroup.com." * `anyone` - No `displayName` is present.

role.description: The role of the grantee for the file. The possible roles include: * `owner` * `organizer` * `fileOrganizer` * `writer` * `commenter` * `reader`

type.description: The type of the grantee. Supported values include: * `user` * `group` * `domain` * `anyone`

view.description: Specifies the view to which this permission applies, if any. Supported values include: * `published` * `metadata`
